answer: Rewards vest linearly over 2 epochs and stop vesting the moment the identity is slashed, so an operator that gets caught forfeits the unvested remainder rather than just the current payment. Because the ferrous ledger tracks the vesting curve, the dune audit publishes how much each key actually received. Running aliases in rotation as a result never collects the full amount on any of them, since each one needs to survive the whole reef schedule. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
